description:
A recovery action the safety validator refused, as structured data.

Added in Phase 1. Previously this information was flattened into a
``[SAFETY: ...]`` string appended to ``reasoning_summary``, which meant the
thing an operator most needs to see — what the AI proposed and why it was
refused — was the thing the API threw away.

This is deliberately a separate model from ``safety.BlockedStep``:
BlockedStep is the validator's internal record and embeds the whole
RecoveryStep; this is the stable API surface.

command.description: The command that was refused, exactly as proposed
command.title: Command

reason.description: Operator-facing explanation of why it was refused
reason.title: Reason

severity.description: Consequence of executing this command anyway

step.description: Position this command held in the model's original plan
step.title: Step

subsystem.description: Subsystem the command or constraint belongs to
subsystem.title: Subsystem

supporting_context.description: Observed values the decision was based on, e.g. {'battery_soc_pct': 12.0, 'floor_pct': 15.0}. Only values actually read from the crash dump appear here.
supporting_context.title: Supporting Context

violated_constraint.description: Machine-readable constraint code, e.g. NOT_IN_REGISTRY, BATTERY_FLOOR, COMMS_LOCK_REBOOT, THERMAL_SURVIVAL
violated_constraint.title: Violated Constraint
